The '''Perlemian Traffic Control''' was a traffic control organization that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It operated at the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian]]&ndash;[[Perlemian node|Perlemian]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] intersection, in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]].
